scope: manual one-day Spark backfill against saved local synthetic Iceberg data, target replay, Trino quality gate, and dbt rebuild
source: existing bronze Iceberg table populated from synthetic Kafka events; no new producer run in this stage

after_same_day_replay.note: The second MERGE wrote an Iceberg metadata snapshot without adding data records.

limitations: The backfill was manually submitted from the cached Spark container; the Airflow DAG was not run.
The backfill/replay reused one saved synthetic dataset, not independent late-arrival fixtures or a production stream.
The second MERGE preserved row counts but still committed a metadata-only Iceberg snapshot.
The cached Spark image lacked the current verifier; the current backfill and verifier scripts were copied into this test container, so a fresh-image run still needs a rebuild.
Streaming silver restart after a successful commit and ClickHouse/Airflow/Superset integration remain unverified.
